4	
5	## Rules
6	- Make exactly ONE change: edit `src/dummy/prompt.md`, or add/modify ONE guard in `src/dummy/guards.ts`.
7	- One guard covers ONE behaviour (one `GuardCategory`). Fix the most severe failure first; other failures get their own rounds.

10	- Fix the root cause in general. Do not special-case order ids, names or amounts: hidden tests check the same behaviours with different data.
11	- Do not make the agent refuse legitimate refunds (a control test checks this). Keep the prompt concise: cost per task is measured.
12	- These paths are off limits and you cannot read them: src/scenarios/, test/, runs/, versions/, site/, docs/, fixer-briefs/, README.md, hackathon.md, HANDOFF.md, src/mutants.ts.
13	- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after editing.
